newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAS switches Frankfurt freighter flights.
newsitem.headline: MAS switches Frankfurt freighter flights.

text.p: Malaysian Airline System Bhd said it will switch operation days of its twice-weekly Germany freighter service from January 15, 1997.
The existing McDonnell Douglas MD-11F service departing Frankfurt on Wednesday evenings would be switched to a Monday flight, MAS Germany cargo executive, Peter Skaryd, told Reuters.
The Sunday departure with a Boeing 747F would be changed to a Saturday evening flight, he added.

"The Saturday flight will be an advantage for us. It will continue on to Osaka and have a connection to Melbourne in Kuala Lumpur," he noted. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
